events.title: Asian Shares Mixed As Investors Digest Fed Decision, Tech Earnings
events.description:
Asian stocks ended mixed on Thursday as investors reacted to the U.S. Federal Reserve's rate decision as well as earnings from tech heavyweights, including Alphabet, Microsoft and Samsung Electronics.
 
Ongoing diplomatic efforts between regional Middle Eastern powers to avoid an escalation between the U.S. and Iran helped limit regional losses, if any.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises As Crude Oil Prices Advance
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, as the crude oil prices surged after reports suggest possible U.S. attacks on Iran by next week, fueling supply disruption concerns for an indefinite period.

events.title: Canadian Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Canadian dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: European Shares Seen Flat To Higher; ECB Meeting Eyed
events.description: European stocks are seen opening flat to slightly higher on Thursday as investors react to the U.S. Federal Reserve's widely expected decision to hold rates unchanged and await the outcome of an ECB policy meeting later in the day amid France's deepening fiscal woes and political gridlock.

events.title: Indian Shares Modestly Higher As Fed Holds Rates Steady
events.description: Indian shares were modestly higher in early trade on Thursday as the U.S. Federal Reserve left interest rates unchanged, as widely expected, and oil prices eased following fresh diplomatic efforts to end the war in the Middle East.

events.title: Australian Market Maintains Early Gains In Mid-market
events.description: The Australian market is maintaining its early gains in mid-market moves on Thursday, reversing the slight losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving well below the 8,850 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Asian Markets Trade Mixed
events.description: Asian markets are trading mixed on Thursday, following the positive cues from Wall Street overnight, as traders are cautiously optimistic after the US Fed left interest rates unchanged despite inflationary pressures amid spiking crude oil prices. However, reports of the possibility of U.S. attacks on Iran by next week are fueling crude oil supply disruption concerns for an indefinite period.

events.title: Indian Shares Seen Tad Higher At Open
events.description: Indian shares are seen opening a tad higher on Thursday, with firm cues from global markets and easing oil prices likely to underpin sentiment at open.

events.title: Thai Stock Market May Halt Losing Streak On Thursday
events.description: The Thai stock market has finished lower in two straight sessions, sliding more than a dozen points or 0.8 percent in that span. The Stock Exchange of Thailand now sits just above the 1,565-point plateau although it may stop the bleeding on Thursday.

events.title: Japanese Market Significantly Higher
events.description: The Japanese market is trading significantly higher on Thursday, extending the gains in the previous two sessions, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The Nikkei 225 is moving well above the 64,550 level, with gains is index heavyweights, financial and technology stocks.

events.title: Indonesia Stock Market May Tick Higher Again On Thursday
events.description: The Indonesia stock market bounced higher again on Wednesday, one day after ending the four-day winning streak in which it had jumped almost 450 points or 8.6 percent. The Jakarta Composite Index now sits just above the 5,280-point plateau and it may open higher again on Thursday.

events.title: Australian Market Modestly Higher
events.description: The Australian market is trading modestly higher on Thursday, reversing the slight losses in the previous session, following the broadly positive cues from Wall Street overnight. The benchmark S&P/ASX 200 is moving well below the 8,850 level, with gains across most sectors led by mining, energy and technology stocks.

events.title: Higher Open Expected For The Hong Kong Stock Market
events.description: The Hong Kong stock market ticked higher again on Wednesday, one day after ending the two-day winning streak in which it had picked up more than 275 points or 1.2 percent. The Hang Seng now sits just beneath the 23,100-point plateau and it figures to open in the upside again on Thursday.
